findings: Global search sometimes misses the low-residual basin on sparse registered scans; an earlier nearby candidate was nearly inverted. Candidate distance alone was not physical position-error evidence.
Fresh-pose preview age previously included slow pre-pose map validation; repaired in b64de0b and deployed as 0d759881.
A stopped observation snapshot older than six seconds becomes UNKNOWN. The handoff gate previously permanently recorded OBSERVATION_SESSION_CHANGED even when identity and inactivity were unchanged.

The latter defect was reproduced with the real observation/handoff classes in an isolated synthetic regression. The live failure did not preserve its exact intermediate snapshot, so the regression establishes a reachable defect, not a complete live timing trace.

handoff_repair_contract.unknown_inactive_same_session: Blocks admission as OUTCOME_UNKNOWN until fresh status is available; preserves the exact accepted stop receipt
handoff_repair_contract.observed_different_session: Permanently invalidates, including when that snapshot is stale
handoff_repair_contract.admission_refresh: When the confirmed inactive monitor cache is stale, preflight and job snapshot admission read actual service status without a service command or cache timestamp renewal. Pending transitions, bridge ownership, changed monitor samples and changed stop receipts fence the read. Status-only requests retain the normal monitor path.
